scope: future source scoring rubric; no extraction, no key derivation, no hashing, no OCR, no address checks

rubricRows.name: source identity
rubricRows.requirement: Material must be physically/original-layout distinct from the byte-locked current scan or duplicate exports.
rubricRows.currentBaseline: Current workspace and Desktop magazine.pdf are byte-identical; current local source set has zero actionable unknowns.
rubricRows.passThreshold: Physical scan/photo, native layout export, browser/source asset, or raw clue source with provenance that is not only a resave of the current PDF.

rubricRows.name: target preservation
rubricRows.requirement: Must preserve or explain the active page-76 lower corridor: O5, G5, L26-L29, and O-B-B-O anchors.
rubricRows.currentBaseline: Active targets: O5 'shitcoiner at heart', G5 'Volcano Bonds', L26 future bitcoin earnings; crop pack has five line/context panels.
rubricRows.passThreshold: O5 and G5 are readable/locatable, plus at least one context band from L25-L32 is visible enough to compare against the crop pack.

rubricRows.name: unit/order evidence
rubricRows.requirement: Must name or visibly supply an extraction unit/order before selector/key checks resume.
rubricRows.currentBaseline: Active unlock matrix checks 8 paths; all 8 fail R3. Existing raw-like clue intake has zero R3 passes.
rubricRows.passThreshold: Source-backed wording or layer metadata names word, letter, line, edge, font, first/last, left/right, fold, mirror read direction, page/order, key/private format, or equivalent.
evidenceToRecord: why it points to page 76 or redirects

rubricRows.name: orientation discipline
rubricRows.requirement: Coordinates must use the correct orientation before comparison.
rubricRows.currentBaseline: 3D/crop layer is readable/upright; source_images and fresh PDF extraction are native upside-down and need rotate180.
rubricRows.passThreshold: New material states/readably shows orientation; comparisons are made in upright coordinates or with documented 180-degree rotation.

rubricRows.name: controlled improvement
rubricRows.requirement: Must improve a compact benchmark without inventing a new arbitrary transform.
rubricRows.currentBaseline: C2 is partial: p78 frame clips O5, cuts M3, and is 38px from G5; dx -38/-40 repairs tri-contact but remains registration evidence only.
rubricRows.passThreshold: Natural source registration preserves/explains O5 bottom contact, M3 right-edge cut, and G5 edge repair, or creates repeated direct O5/G5 physical contacts.

extractionGate.allowExtractionOnlyIf: R1, R2, R3, R4, and R5 all pass on the same new source/clue item, with R3 providing a source-backed unit/order.
blockIf: R3 is absent, even if target geometry improves.
material is only a duplicate/resaved current scan.
orientation is ambiguous or mixed between upright/native coordinates.
geometry requires arbitrary shifts not explained by source/physical evidence.
firstAllowedActionsAfterPass: run one low-parameter extraction following the source-backed rule
only then test checksum-valid key-like output or address activity

nextMove: Use this rubric together with the source-acquisition packet when new physical/original-layout/raw clue material appears. Do not resume extraction from the current scan.
